prompt:
On US builds the instrument cluster keeps showing km/h and km. The init script sets the unit property as intended: adb shell getprop persist.vendor.car.display_units prints imperial, and the cluster log says
I ClusterUnits: display units from property: metric
Find the fault in packages/apps/Car/Cluster. Answer with the file and the function that contain it, and one sentence on why. Do not change any file.
reference_answer: packages/apps/Car/Cluster/src/com/android/car/cluster/DisplayUnitsReader.java, readUnits: it reads persist.vendor.car.display_unit (KEY_UNITS) without the final s, while the init script sets persist.vendor.car.display_units, so it always gets the default metric.
